notes: Added missing core logic, tests, and integration stories to complete feature coverage.

GOV-F-003-S47.title: Brain Lock Core TTL and Ownership Logic
GOV-F-003-S47.description: Implement core lock acquisition, renewal, expiration (TTL enforcement), and ownership validation logic. Ensure expired locks are automatically treated as releasable and prevent concurrent ownership conflicts.

GOV-F-003-S48.title: Brain Lock Expiration and Recovery Handling
GOV-F-003-S48.description: Implement recovery logic for stale or orphaned locks including TTL expiry detection, forced unlock conditions, and safe takeover by new owners. Include safeguards for partial executions and retry scenarios.

GOV-F-003-S49.title: Brain Lock Unit and Integration Tests
GOV-F-003-S49.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, TTL expiry, concurrent access contention, recovery flows, and failure scenarios. Validate behavior under race conditions and multi-agent execution.
